title: COSE_Sign1 structure
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; RFC 8152 CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE). QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “The resulting structure is 18([protected, unprotected, payload, signature]).”.

statements.label: COSE_Sign1 structure
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL emit 18([protected bstr, unprotected map, payload bstr, signature bstr]). The verifier SHALL accept the tagged form and SHOULD also accept an untagged COSE_Sign1 array.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-COS-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-COS-001 STT-COS-003 a tagged COSE_Sign1 with alg and kid in the protected header` (SignCoseTest.kt)).
